subject: Request: 25% Hosted API concession for Pollard Health — Q1 pilot to enterprise
messages:
From: Evan Pollard <evan.pollard@pollardhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Zhou <clara.zhou@pollardhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing for Q1 pilot

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with latency and the billing transparency. We'd like to move forward with a Q1 pilot (3 months) targeting 7M tokens/month and a plan to scale to 60M tokens/month if the pilot succeeds.

Budget note: our procurement cap for pilots is tight. Can Redwood offer a pilot rate of $0.00048/token (25% off the list Hosted API rate) for the first 90 days, with an option to convert to standard committed pricing on success?

If you can confirm this, I'll route PO approval next week.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Pollard
Head of Platform
Pollard Health

Attachments: N/A
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing for Q1 pilot — Pollard Health (requesting approval)

Ben/Marcus — forwarding Pollard's ask (25% pilot discount to $0.00048/token). Pilot size ~7M tokens/month with expansion potential to ~60M/month in 3–6 months. They want the pilot discount to apply for 90 days and then convert to our normal hosted committed tiers.

Rationale: vertical leader in regional clinics, good reference potential, likely multi-region rollout if pilot metrics hold. Risks: unit economics hit short-term; we can gate by usage and SLOs.

Attached: my estimated rate model and draft SOW. Can we get senior approval for >20% concession for pilot? If yes, what's the formal signoff language/conditions (finance/OPS guardrails, cap on total discounted spend)?

Thanks — Stephanie
---
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing for Q1 pilot — Pollard Health (requesting approval)

Stephanie — thanks for the context. Quick thoughts:
- 25% off list for Hosted API is outside standard delegated authority for AEs.
- Pilot volume (7M/mo) at $0.00048/token equals ~$3.36k/month — low ARR but high upside if they ramp.
- Need finance to sign off on short-term unit economics and a cap (e.g., discount applies to first $20k of billed usage or first 90 days, whichever hits first).

Marcus — can you authorize a one-time pilot concession at 25% with the following guardrails?
  * Max discounted spend: $20,000 over 90 days
  * Conversion clause: if usage >30M tokens/month within 90 days, discount terminates and we migrate to committed pricing within 30 days
  * Legal to sign SOW with standard T&Cs

If you approve, I'll confirm with Pollard and send SOW for PO.

—Ben
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing for Q1 pilot — Pollard Health (requesting approval)

Ben/Stephanie — I reviewed the model and the strategic rationale. I approve a 25% Hosted API concession for Pollard Health for an initial 90-day pilot under these conditions:

1) Discount applies only to Hosted API token usage and is limited to a total discounted spend of $20,000 across the pilot. Any usage beyond that cap billed at list pricing.
2) If Pollard exceeds 30M tokens/month during the pilot, we will pause the discount for the period >30M and engage to convert to committed pricing (sales + finance to propose structure within 7 business days).
3) Legal must review and sign the SOW; finance to confirm billing cadence and revenue recognition treatment.
4) Customer to provide a named internal sponsor and agree to a short evaluation metric (latency <200ms p95 and accuracy baseline) to qualify for future expansion incentives.

Stephanie — notify Pollard of approval, include the guardrails, and attach the SOW for signature. Finance (cc'd) should validate the $20k cap in the SOW. I'll log approval in the deal record (PD-2028-111).

Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Evan Pollard <evan.pollard@pollardhealth.com>
Cc: Clara Zhou <clara.zhou@pollardhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for Q1 pilot

Hi Evan — great news. Marcus has approved a 25% pilot concession to $0.00048/token for the 90-day pilot under the conditions below (copied verbatim):

- The discount covers Hosted API token usage up to a maximum discounted spend of $20,000 over the 90-day pilot. Usage beyond the $20k discounted cap will be billed at list price.
- If usage exceeds 30M tokens/month in the pilot, the discount on incremental usage will be paused and we will work to convert to committed pricing within 7 business days.
- Legal review & SOW signature required prior to pilot start; Finance will confirm billing cadence.
- Pollard to designate an internal sponsor and agree to the evaluation metrics (latency p95 <200ms; key accuracy checks).

I'm attaching the SOW draft and our Q1 estimates. Please confirm you accept these conditions and share PO timing; Legal will push the SOW once you confirm.

Thanks — excited to get Pollard onboarded.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Pollard_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, Pollard_Rate_Model_Q1_estimates.xlsx
